cohort: 5895 pregnant women who delivered from April 2016 to March 2017 and 5103 pregnant women who delivered from January to December 2015
finding: After the implementation of the two-child policy, there was an increase in the percentage of older, multiparous pregnant women, as well as an increase in pregnancy complications and cesarean section rates in multiparous women.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate during primipara was significantly reduced after the implementation of the two-child policy, however, the rate during multipara was significantly increased.
